researchNotes: Names taken from the Cologne Sprays collection (299 results, 7 pages) on demeterfragrance.com, the Demeter Fragrance Library storefront; product names there carry the suffix 'Cologne Spray', which was stripped from the name and recorded as concentration. That site does not mention The Library of Fragrance; the equivalence (European trade name of Demeter Fragrance Library, New York) comes from a web search result summarising https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demeter_Fragrance_Library. thelibraryoffragrance.com shows only a 'Launching Soon' page. Collection page lists no notes, so notes are empty for all entries; no notes inferred from names. Items not in the Cologne Sprays collection (other formats, sets, Dark Flowers etc.) were not enumerated. Black Tea and Swimming Pool showed 'Sold Out' on the listing (not marked discontinued).
